parameters.query:
SELECT (
    SELECT json_build_object(
        'orderId', order_id,
        'sku', sku,
        'productName', product_name,
        'channel', channel,
        'deliveredOn', to_char(delivered_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
        'warrantyMonths', warranty_months,
        'requiresSerial', requires_serial
    )
    FROM jaleco.pedidos
    WHERE order_id = $1
) AS pedido
